description.zh:
传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码。
> FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个。
description.en:
The Base64-encoded content of the facial image.
> Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64.
Set the value to **IMAGE** to specify a facial image.

description.zh:
传入人脸图片URL地址。
> FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个。
description.en:
The URL of the facial image.
> Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64.

description.zh: 商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列。
description.en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character combination of letters and digits. The first few characters are a custom merchant abbreviation, the middle part can contain a timestamp, and the last part can be a random or incremental sequence.

description.zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值：**FACE_DEEPFAKE**
description.en: The product solution to use. Set the value to **FACE_DEEPFAKE**.

description.zh: 您自定义的认证场景ID，用于后续控制台输入此场景ID查询相关记录使用。支持长度为10位的字母、数字或下划线的组合。
description.en: The custom scene ID for authentication. You can use this scene ID to query related records in the console. The value can be up to 10 characters long and can contain letters, digits, and underscores.

descriptions.zh: 传入人脸图片，通过算法检测是否存在深度伪造风险。包含AIGC生成人脸、深度伪造换脸、模板人脸、翻拍人脸等风险场景，输出风险标签与置信度。
descriptions.en: Submits a facial image and uses algorithms to detect potential deepfake risks. This operation covers risk scenarios such as AIGC-generated faces, deep forgery face swaps, template faces, and recaptured faces. It returns risk labels and confidence scores.
